faq.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. The change takes effect immediately.
No. The free plan is permanent — no trial period, no credit card required. You get 5 posts a month, forever.

faq.q: Which AI is used to generate posts?
faq.a: LinkedInForge is powered by Google's Gemini, one of the most advanced language models on the market.

faq.q: Are 'Soon' features included in the price?
faq.a: Yes. Every feature listed as 'Soon' will be included in your plan at no extra cost as soon as it ships.

workflow.title: You provide the content. LinkedInForge handles the rest.
workflow.subtitle: From raw material to high-impact posts in 4 clear steps.

steps.title: 01 — Your content
steps.body: Drop a video, paste an URL, or type a simple raw idea.

steps.title: 02 — AI Analysis
steps.body: The AI extracts key angles, core arguments, and takeaways.

steps.title: 03 — Adaptation & Writing
steps.body: The Ghostwriter applies your authentic tone and formats for maximum engagement.

steps.title: 04 — Ready to publish
steps.body: Preview, fine-tune in one click, and share directly across your channels.

omnichannel.title: One source of content. Custom posts for each platform.
omnichannel.body: Stop wasting hours rewriting the same message. LinkedInForge adapts your story to the native format of each network.
omnichannel.videoNote: From long-form LinkedIn storytelling to short video scripts: every network gets its tailored format.

whyUs.title: LinkedInForge doesn't generate random text.
whyUs.subtitle: It understands your content before writing.

reasons.title: 01 — Understands the source
reasons.body: Audio, visual ingestion, webpage scraping or raw text brief analysis.

reasons.title: 02 — Identifies context
reasons.body: Extracts key insights, data points, and actionable takeaways.

reasons.title: 03 — Adapts your voice
reasons.body: Applies your Ghostwriter persona (tone, pacing, formatting and vocabulary).

reasons.title: 04 — Crafts the post
reasons.body: Magnetic hook, clean spacing, hashtags and Hero visual extracted in real time.
